name: American Decades
description: A musical road trip through the United States, one original sketch for every decade since 1776: fife and drum, minuets and reels, shape-note hymns, spirituals and parlor songs, Civil War bugles and cowboy trails, Sousa-style marches, ragtime, barbershop, Dixieland and the Charleston, swing and boogie-woogie, doo-wop, Motown and disco, electro and boom bap, pop-punk, EDM and hyperpop. Every tune is newly written in the style of its era.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: 1770s · Liberty Fife
sketches.description: The Revolution marches by: a fife and drum corps in G, the shrill fife over snare rudiments, a bass drum and boots on a dirt road.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 2/4: a fife and drum corps on the march, in G
fife: note("<[g5 a5 b5 g5] [a5 b5 [c6 b5] a5] [b5 c6 d6 b5] [a5 [b5 a5] g5 d5] [g5 a5 b5 g5] [a5 b5 [c6 b5] a5] [b5 [a5 g5] a5 f#5] [g5@2 g5 ~]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(6).vibdepth(.06)
  .attack(.01).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05)
  .space("outdoor").room(.3).gain(.28)

// Snare rudiments: open strokes and buzzing doubles
snare: s("[sd sd] [sd sd sd sd] [sd sd] [sd sd sd sd]").gain(".45 .25 .4 .25")
  .hpf(400).space("outdoor").room(.3)

// The bass drum on the beat, and boots on the road
bassdrum: s("lt ~ lt ~").speed(.7).lpf(500).gain(.5)
steps: s("step ~ step ~").distance(3).gain(.18)

sketches.name: 1780s · Philadelphia Minuet
sketches.description: Candlelit drawing rooms of the new republic: a minuet in D for harpsichord and string quartet, with a clock ticking on the mantel.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/3)

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4: a minuet for the drawing rooms of the new republic, in D
harpsichord: note("<[d5 f#5 a5] [g5@2 e5] [f#5 d5 b4] [a4@3] [b4 d5 g5] [f#5 e5 d5] [e5 a4 c#5] [d5@3]>")
  .s("square").pw(.15).attack(.002).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.15)
  .lpf(3500).room(.35).gain(.18)

// The left hand: a broken bass on each beat
left: note("<[d3 a3 f#3] [g2 b3 g3] [d3 b3 g3] [a2 c#3 e3] [g2 d3 b3] [d3 a3 f#3] [a2 e3 g3] [d3 a3 d4]>")
  .s("square").pw(.2).attack(.002).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.1)
  .lpf(2200).room(.35).gain(.14)

// A string quartet holding the harmony
strings: note("<[d4,f#4] [b3,e4] [b3,d4] [c#4,e4] [b3,d4] [a3,d4] [c#4,g4] [d4,f#4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.08).lpf(1800)
  .attack(.15).sustain(.6).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.12)

// A clock on the mantel
clock: s("tick ~ ~").gain(.05)

sketches.name: 1790s · Federal Reel
sketches.description: A country dance in a tavern hall: a fiddle reel in A over a drone, a vamping keyboard and dancers' feet on the wooden floor.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)

// A contra dance reel in A: the fiddle calls, the dancers answer with their feet
fiddle: note("<[a4 c#5 e5 c#5 a4 c#5 e5 a5] [f#5 e5 d5 c#5 b4 a4 b4 c#5] [d5 f#5 a5 f#5 e5 c#5 a4 c#5] [b4 g#4 e4 g#4 a4@2 ~ e4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(3000)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.1).attack(.02).decay(.15).sustain(.5).release(.08)
  .room(.3).gain(.28)

// A second fiddle drones the open strings
drone: note("[a3,e4]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(1400)
  .attack(.1).sustain(1).release(.3).gain(.1)

// A keyboard vamping A, D, A, E: bass on the beat, chords off it
vamp: note("<a2 d2 a2 e2>").struct("x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.2).sustain(0).gain(.3)
chords: note("<[c#4,e4,a4] [d4,f#4,a4] [c#4,e4,a4] [b3,e4,g#4]>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.2)

// Feet on the wooden floor
feet: s("step ~ step ~ step ~ step step").lpf(1500).gain(.25)

sketches.name: 1800s · Fuguing Tune
sketches.description: Shape-note singing from the new tunebooks: three parts in a hollow square, open fifths in A minor, and the leader's hand beating time.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// Shape-note singing: parts facing each other in a hollow square, open fifths and all
treble: note("<[a4 c5 b4 a4] [g4@2 e4@2] [a4 b4 c5 d5] [e5@4] [d5 c5 b4 a4] [g4 a4 b4 g4] [a4 e4 g4 e4] [a4@4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("ah").attack(.1).release(.4).pan(.3).room(.4).gain(.22)
tenor: note("<[e4 e4 d4 e4] [d4@2 b3@2] [e4 g4 a4 b4] [a4@4] [g4 a4 g4 e4] [d4 e4 d4 b3] [c4 b3 d4 b3] [e4@4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("oh").attack(.1).release(.4).pan(.6).room(.4).gain(.24)
bass: note("<[a2 a2 g2 a2] [g2@2 e2@2] [a2 e2 a2 g2] [a2@4] [g2 a2 e2 c3] [g2 e2 g2 e2] [a2 e2 e2 e2] [a2@4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("oo").attack(.1).release(.4).room(.4).gain(.26)

// The leader's hand beating time on the bench
beat: s("rim ~ rim ~").lpf(1200).gain(.12)

sketches.name: 1810s · Ramparts at Dawn
sketches.description: The War of 1812: a military band on the fort walls, massed brass in Bb, a bugle above, a rolling snare and cannon on the far shore.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)

// A military band on the ramparts: massed brass in Bb
brass: note("<[[bb3,d4,f4]@3 [bb3,d4,f4]] [c4,eb4,f4,a4] [[bb3,d4,f4,bb4] [eb4,g4,bb4]] [[d4,f4,bb4] [c4,f4,a4]]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(1400).lpenv(1.5).lpattack(.05)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.7).release(.3).room(.5).gain(.22)

// A bugle melody above
bugle: note("<[f4@3 f4 bb4@2 d5@2] [c5@4 a4@2 f4@2] [bb4@2 d5 f5 eb5@2 g5@2] [f5@2 d5@2 c5@3 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2600).vib(5).vibdepth(.06)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.7).release(.2).room(.5).gain(.22)

// Snare and bass drum keeping the cadence
snare: s("[sd ~ sd sd] [sd ~ sd ~] [sd ~ sd sd] [sd sd sd sd]").hpf(300).gain(.3)
bassdrum: s("bd ~ bd ~").speed(.8).lpf(600).gain(.45)

// Cannon on the far shore, now and then
cannon: s("<~ ~ ~ [bd ~ ~ ~]>").speed(.4).lpf(300).distance(8).room(.8).gain(.7)

sketches.name: 1820s · Canal Days
sketches.description: Down the new Erie Canal: a hammered dulcimer and a fiddle in D mixolydian, a boot on the deck, a jug for a bass and water lapping the hull.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// A hammered dulcimer rippling through D, D, G and A
dulcimer: n("0 2 4 2 6 4 2 4").add("<0 0 3 4>").scale("D:mixolydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2.5).fmh(3).decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .pan(.35).room(.4).gain(.22)

// The fiddle plays the tune
fiddle: note("<[a4@2 b4 c5 d5@2 c5 a4] [g4@3 a4 b4@2 g4 e4] [d4 e4 g4 a4 b4@2 a4 g4] [a4 g4 e4 c5 a4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(2800).vib(6).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.15).pan(.65).room(.4).gain(.24)

// A boot stomping on the deck, and a jug for the bass
stomp: s("bd ~ bd ~").lpf(400).gain(.4)
jug: note("<[d2 ~ a1 ~] [d2 ~ a1 ~] [g1 ~ d2 ~] [a1 ~ e2 ~]>")
  .s("sine").vowel("o").shape(.1).decay(.25).sustain(.2).gain(.4)

// Water against the hull
water: s("stream").slow(4).distance(3).gain(.15)

sketches.name: 1830s · Call and Response
sketches.description: In the tradition of the spirituals and work songs that became the roots of American music: a leader calls, voices answer, hands clap and feet stomp.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)

// The leader calls...
leader: note("<[g4@2 a4 c5 a4@4] ~ [c5@2 d5 c5 a4@2 g4@2] ~>")
  .s("voice").syl("<[oh@2 lo ro da@4] ~ [wa@2 ko mi ho@2 ma@2] ~>")
  .voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.1).attack(.05).release(.8).room(.5).gain(.34)

// ...and the voices answer
answer: note("<~ [[g3,b3,d4]@2 [a3,c4,e4] [g3,b3,d4]@5] ~ [[c4,e4,g4]@2 [a3,c4,e4]@2 [g3,b3,d4]@4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("<~ oh ~ ah>").attack(.1).release(1).room(.5).gain(.3)

// Hands and feet keep the time
claps: s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.3)
stomp: s("bd ~ bd ~").lpf(300).gain(.45)
drone: note("g2").slow(4).s("hum").gain(.12)

sketches.name: 1840s · Forty-Niner Campfire
sketches.description: The Gold Rush, 1849: a banjo, a concertina and a pair of spoons around a campfire under the Sierra stars, with crickets in the dark.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// The campfire
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.4).density(8).gain(.25)

// Banjo rolls through C, F, C and G
banjo: note("<[c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4 g4 e4] [f4 a4 c5 f5 c5 a4 c5 a4] [c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4 g4 e4] [g3 b3 d4 g4 f4 d4 b3 g3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.001).decay(.15).sustain(0).release(.15)
  .pan(.35).gain(.26)

// A wheezing concertina sings the tune
concertina: note("<[e5@2 d5 c5 e5@2 g5@2] [a5@2 g5 f5 c5@4] [e5 f5 g5 e5 c5@2 d5 e5] [d5@2 b4 g4 d5@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("a").lpf(2200)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.7).release(.15).trem(6).tremdepth(.15)
  .pan(.65).room(.3).gain(.2)

// A plucked bass, spoons on a knee, crickets in the dark
bass: note("<[c2 g2]*2 [f2 c3]*2 [c2 g2]*2 [g1 d2]*2>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.2).sustain(.2).gain(.4)
spoons: s("rim*8").speed(1.4).lpf(4000).gain("[.25 .1 .15 .1]*2")
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(6).gain(.06)

sketches.name: 1850s · Parlor Ballad
sketches.description: A sentimental song around the family piano, in the manner of the era's parlor songwriters: a singing tune in F over gentle arpeggios.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// Gentle piano arpeggios: F, Bb, F, C7, F, Dm, C7, F
piano: note("<[f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [bb1 f2 d3 f2 bb2 f2 d3 f2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3] [d2 a2 f3 a2 d3 a2 f3 a2] [c2 g2 e3 g2 bb2 g2 e3 g2] [f2 c3 a3 c3 f3 c3 a3 c3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(.8).sustain(.1).release(.8)
  .room(.4).gain(.3)

// A voice sings the ballad
singer: note("<[a4@3 g4 f4@2 a4@2] [bb4@3 a4 g4@4] [a4@2 c5@2 d5 c5 a4@2] [g4@6 ~@2] [a4@3 g4 f4@2 d4@2] [d4@2 f4@2 a4@2 g4@2] [f4@2 a4@2 g4@2 e4@2] [f4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<[la@3 li lo@2 ma@2] [ho@3 ma la@4] [do@2 ri@2 ma no la@2] [ho@6 ~@2] [la@3 li lo@2 ma@2] [so@2 ri@2 mi@2 na@2] [lo@2 va@2 ho@2 mo@2] [ho@6 ~@2]>")
  .mono(1).vglide(.08).attack(.1).release(.6).room(.4).gain(.32)

// The clock in the parlor
clock: s("tick ~ tick ~").gain(.05)

sketches.name: 1860s · Evening in Camp
sketches.description: The Civil War: a bugle call drifts across the field at dusk, then a fiddle plays a lament by the fire over a soft harmonium and a muffled drum.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// A bugle sounds across the field
bugle: note("<[g3@2 g3 c4@5] [e4@2 c4 e4 g4@4] [e4@2 c4 g3 c4@4] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2000)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.7).release(.6).distance(6).room(.7).gain(.3)

// Then a fiddle plays a lament by the fire
fiddle: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ [e4@3 a4 c5@2 b4 a4] [g4@4 e4@4] [f4@2 e4 d4 c4@2 b3 c4] [a3@8]>")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.15).lpf(2400)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.24)
harmonium: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ [a2,e3,a3] [c3,e3,g3] [d3,f3,a3] [a2,e3,a3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("organ").lpf(900).attack(.5).sustain(.6).release(1).gain(.1)

// A muffled drum, the fire and the crickets
drum: s("<[lt ~ ~ ~] ~ [lt ~ ~ ~] ~ [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ ~ ~]>")
  .speed(.8).lpf(600).room(.5).gain(.35)
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.3).gain(.2)
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(6).gain(.06)

sketches.name: 1870s · Up the Cattle Trail
sketches.description: Driving cattle north: a horse's lope, a strummed guitar, a harmonica under a big sky and the prairie wind.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// A horse's lope
hooves: s("[rim@2 rim]*4").speed(.7).lpf(1800).pan(.4).gain(.25)

// A guitar strumming in the lope rhythm: G, C, G, D7
guitar: note("<[g2,d3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3,c4] [g2,d3,g3,b3] [d3,f#3,a3,c4]>").struct("[x@2 x]*4")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.003).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .lpf(2400).gain(.24)
bass: note("<[g1 d2] [c2 g1] [g1 d2] [d2 a1]>").s("triangle").decay(.3).sustain(.3).gain(.4)

// A harmonica sings over the herd
harmonica: note("<[d5@2 b4 g4 b4@2 d5@2] [e5@4 c5@2 g4@2] [d5@2 b4 d5 g5@2 e5 d5] [c5@2 a4@2 f#4@2 d4@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o").mono(1).glide(.04)
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.2).attack(.04).sustain(.6).release(.2)
  .lpf(2400).room(.4).gain(.24)

// The prairie wind
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.25).gain(.08)

sketches.name: 1880s · Bandstand March
sketches.description: Sunday in the park: a brass band strikes up a march in 6/8, with oom-pah tuba, bright cornets, piccolo trills and crashing cymbals.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 6/8: oom-pah tuba through Eb, Bb7 and Ab
tuba: note("<[eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [ab1 ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(500).attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.45)
horns: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [d3,f3,ab3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,ab3,c4] [eb3,g3,bb3] [d3,f3,ab3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1500).decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.2)

// Cornets carry the tune
cornet: note("<[bb4@2 g4 eb5@2 bb4] [c5@2 bb4 g4@3] [ab4@2 f4 d5@2 bb4] [eb5@6] [c5@2 eb5 ab5@2 g5] [g5@2 f5 eb5@3] [d5@2 eb5 f5@2 ab5] [g5@3 eb5@3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(3000).vib(5).vibdepth(.05)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.7).release(.1).room(.4).gain(.26)

// Piccolo trills at the end of each phrase
piccolo: note("<~ ~ ~ [g6 ab6 g6 ab6 g6 ab6] ~ ~ ~ [eb6 f6 eb6 f6 eb6 f6]>")
  .s("sine").decay(.1).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.12)

// Bass drum, snare and cymbals
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~, sd ~ sd sd ~ sd").gain(.45)
cymbals: s("cr ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").gain(.12)

sketches.name: 1890s · Riverboat Rag
sketches.description: Ragtime on a Mississippi riverboat: the left hand strides between bass notes and chords while the right hand syncopates against it.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 2/4: the left hand strides
left: note("<[c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [f2 [f3,a3,c4] c2 [f3,a3,c4]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [a1 [e3,a3,c#4] e2 [e3,a3,c#4]] [d2 [f3,a3,c4] g1 [f3,g3,b3]] [c2 [e3,g3,c4] ~ ~]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.003).decay(.3).sustain(.1).release(.2)
  .lpf(2400).gain(.3)

// The right hand syncopates against it
right: note("<[e5 g5 ~ e5 c6@2 g5 e5] [g5@2 e5 c5@2 d5 e5@2] [f5 a5 ~ f5 c6@2 a5 f5] [a5@2 f5 c5@2 d5 f5@2] [e5 g5 ~ e5 c6@2 g5 e5] [e5 a5 ~ c#6 e6@2 c#6 a5] [d6@2 c6 a5 g5@2 f5 d5] [c5@3 c6 ~@4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.25).sustain(.15).release(.15)
  .lpf(3500).gain(.26)

// The chatter of the saloon deck
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.25).gain(.08)

sketches.name: 1900s · Streetlamp Harmony
sketches.description: A barbershop quartet under a gas lamp: a lead voice with three close-harmony parts swinging around the circle of fifths in Bb.

sketches.name: 1910s · Levee Stomp
sketches.description: Early New Orleans jazz: trumpet lead, a noodling clarinet and a sliding trombone over tuba, banjo and a two-beat drum.
sketches.source:
setcpm(176/4)

// Tuba and banjo: Bb, Bb, Eb, Ebm6, Bb, Gm7, Cm7-F7, Bb
tuba: note("<[bb1 ~ f1 ~] [bb1 ~ f1 ~] [eb2 ~ bb1 ~] [eb2 ~ bb1 ~] [bb1 ~ f2 ~] [g1 ~ d2 ~] [c2 ~ f1 ~] [bb1 ~ f1 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(500).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.45)
banjo: note("<[bb2,d3,f3] [bb2,d3,f3] [eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,gb3,bb3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3] [[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [f3,a3,eb4]] [bb2,d3,f3]>")
  .struct("x x x x").s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.12).sustain(0).gain(.18)

// The trumpet leads
trumpet: note("<[d5@3 f5 d5@2 bb4@2] [c5 d5 ~ bb4 f4@4] [g4@2 bb4 eb5 g5@2 f5 eb5] [eb5@2 db5 bb4 gb4@4] [f4 bb4 d5 f5 ~ d5 bb4@2] [bb4@2 d5 f5 g5@2 f5 d5] [eb5@2 c5 bb4 a4@2 c5 eb5] [d5@4 bb4@2 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2800).vib(5.5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.1).swing(4).gain(.24)

// The clarinet noodles above, the trombone slides below
clarinet: n("[7 9 11 9 7 4 2 4]").add("<0 0 3 0 0 5 1 0>").scale("C:major").transpose(10)
  .mask("<1 1 1 0 1 1 1 1>")
  .s("square").pw(.4).lpf(2400).decay(.15).sustain(.3).swing(4).pan(.7).gain(.12)
trombone: note("<[bb2@4 f3@4] [d3@4 bb2@4] [eb3@4 g3@4] [eb3@4 gb2@4] [d3@4 f3@4] [bb2@4 d3@4] [c3@4 a2@4] [bb2@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").mono(1).glide(.12).lpf(1200)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.6).release(.15).pan(.35).gain(.2)

// A two-beat drum and woodblocks
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd").swing(4).gain(.45)
blocks: s("rim*4").speed(.8).gain(.15)

sketches.name: 1920s · Charleston Fever
sketches.description: The Roaring Twenties: hot cornet over the Charleston rhythm, piano and handclaps on the famous dotted kick, tuba, banjo and a crisp kit.
sketches.source:
setcpm(216/4)

// Piano and claps on the Charleston rhythm: C, C, E7, E7, A7, D7, G7, C
piano: note("<[c3,e3,g3] [c3,e3,g3] [e3,g#3,b3,d4] [e3,g#3,b3,d4] [a2,c#3,e3,g3] [d3,f#3,a3,c4] [g2,b2,d3,f3] [c3,e3,g3,c4]>")
  .struct("x@3 x@5").s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .decay(.3).sustain(.1).release(.2).lpf(2600).gain(.28)
claps: s("cp").struct("x@3 x@5").room(.2).gain(.25)

// Banjo on every beat, tuba on one and three
banjo: note("<[c3,e3,g3] [c3,e3,g3] [e3,g#3,b3,d4] [e3,g#3,b3,d4] [a2,c#3,e3,g3] [d3,f#3,a3,c4] [g2,b2,d3,f3] [c3,e3,g3,c4]>")
  .struct("x x x x").s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.1).sustain(0).pan(.3).gain(.14)
tuba: note("<[c2 g1] [c2 g1] [e2 b1] [e2 b1] [a1 e2] [d2 a1] [g1 d2] [c2 g1]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(600).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.45)

// Hot cornet with a growl
cornet: note("<[e5 g5 ~ e5 c5@2 ~@2] [g4 a4 c5 e5 d5@4] [g#4 b4 ~ d5 e5@2 ~@2] [d5 b4 g#4 e4 g#4@4] [a4 c#5 ~ e5 g5@2 e5 c#5] [d5@2 c5 a4 f#4@4] [g4 b4 d5 f5 e5@2 d5 b4] [c5@4 ~@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").vowel("a").lpf(3000).vib(6).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.1).pan(.6).room(.3).gain(.24)

// A crisp kit
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*4").gain(.4)

sketches.name: 1930s · Ballroom Swing
sketches.description: The big band era: a swinging ride cymbal, a walking bass, a sax section trading riffs and brass shouts at the end of each phrase.
sketches.source:
setcpm(144/4)

// A swinging kit: feathered kick, hats on two and four, ride ding-ding-a-ding
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").lpf(200).gain(.35),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.3),
  s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(.25),
  s("~ ~ ~ [~@2 sd?0.4]").gain(.2)
)

// A walking bass: F, F, Bb, Bb, F, C, F, C
bass: note("<[f2 a2 c3 a2] [f2 a2 c3 eb3] [bb1 d2 f2 d2] [bb1 d2 f2 b1] [f2 a2 c3 d3] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [f2 a2 c3 a2] [c2 e2 g2 e2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.5)

// The sax section riffs, moving with the chords
saxes: note("[[a3,c4,f4]@2 [a3,c4,f4]] [~@2 [bb3,d4,f4]] [[a3,c4,f4]@2 ~] ~").add("<0 0 5 5 0 7 0 7>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1800)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.1).pan(.4).gain(.2)

// Brass shouts at the end of each phrase
shout: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ [[f4,g4,bb4,d5]@2 [f4,g4,bb4,d5]] [f4,g4,bb4,d5]] ~ ~ ~ [~ ~ [[e4,g4,bb4,c5]@2 [e4,g4,bb4,c5]] [e4,g4,bb4,c5]]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(2400).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02)
  .attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.1).pan(.6).room(.3).gain(.24)

sketches.name: 1940s · Home Front Boogie
sketches.description: Wartime boogie-woogie: a rolling eight-to-the-bar left hand through a twelve-bar blues in G, right-hand chord stabs, close-harmony 'ooh' voices and a shuffle beat.

sketches.name: 1950s · Street Corner Doo-Wop
sketches.description: Rock 'n' roll's sweet side: triplet piano, a walking bass, a honking sax and 'ooh' harmonies around C, Am, F and G, over a backbeat.

sketches.name: 1960s · Motor City Soul
sketches.description: The Detroit sound: snare and tambourine on every beat, a melodic bass, piano on the quarters, soaring strings, horn stabs and 'ooh' backing voices.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// Snare on every beat, bright tambourine-like hats and claps
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [~ bd] ~").gain(.6),
  s("sd*4").gain(.4),
  s("hh*8").hpf(6000).gain("[.3 .15]*4"),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.3)
)

// A melodic bass: C, Am, Dm, G
bass: note("<[c2 ~ c2 e2 g2 ~ a2 g2] [a1 ~ a1 c2 e2 ~ g2 e2] [d2 ~ d2 f2 a2 ~ c3 a2] [g1 ~ g1 b1 d2 ~ f2 d2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Piano on the quarters, backing voices underneath
piano: note("<[e4,g4,c5] [e4,a4,c5] [f4,a4,d5] [f4,g4,b4,d5]>").struct("x x x x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.2).sustain(.1).lpf(2600).gain(.2)
voices: note("<[e3,g3] [e3,a3] [f3,a3] [f3,b3]>").s("ooh").attack(.2).release(.6).gain(.18)

// Soaring strings and horn stabs
strings: note("<[g4@2 e5@2 d5 c5@3] [c5@4 e5@4] [f5@2 d5@2 a4 c5@3] [b4@4 d5@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(3000)
  .attack(.15).sustain(.7).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.14)
horns: note("<~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [e4,g4,c5] ~ [e4,g4,c5]] ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ [f4,b4,d5]@2 [g4,b4,d5]@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(2000).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02)
  .attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).pan(.65).gain(.24)

sketches.name: 1970s · Mirror Ball
sketches.description: Saturday night at the discotheque: four on the floor, an octave-jumping bass, chicken-scratch guitar, electric piano and sweeping strings.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// Four on the floor with open hats on the off-beat
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").gain(.8),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.35),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.45),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain("[.18 .08]*8")
)

// The octave bass: Am7, D9, Fmaj7, E7
bass: note("<[a1 a2]*4 [d2 d3]*4 [f1 f2]*4 [e1 e2]*4>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(900).lpenv(1.5).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.45)

// Chicken-scratch guitar and electric piano
guitar: note("<[c4,e4,g4] [c4,f#4,a4] [c4,f4,a4] [b3,e4,g#4]>")
  .struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x")
  .s("square").pw(.2).hpf(900).decay(.05).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.12)
keys: note("<[a3,c4,e4,g4] [c4,e4,f#4,a4] [a3,c4,e4,f4] [g#3,b3,d4,e4]>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.4).pan(.6).gain(.22)

// Sweeping strings
strings: note("<[e5@3 g5 a5@4] [f#5@3 e5 d5@4] [c5@2 e5@2 f5 e5 c5 a4] [g#4@4 b4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.25).lpf(3500)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(.4).room(.6).gain(.14)

sketches.name: 1980s · Electro Breakdance
sketches.description: Drum machines take over: a syncopated electro kick, claps, orchestra-hit stabs, a robot voice from a vocoder and a square-wave lead.
sketches.source:
setcpm(126/4)

// A drum machine with a tom fill every fourth bar
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").shape(.2).gain(.8),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.5),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.3 .12 .2 .12]*4"),
  s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ lt mt ht lt mt ht ht ht ht ht]>").gain(.4)
)

// A synth bass: E, E, C, D
bass: note("e1 ~ e1 ~ ~ e2 ~ e1 ~ ~ g1 ~ a1 ~ b1 ~").add("<0 0 -4 -2>")
  .s("sine").shape(.3).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Orchestra-hit stabs
stabs: note("<[e3,g3,b3,e4] [e3,g3,b3,e4] [c3,e3,g3,c4] [d3,f#3,a3,d4]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3).attack(.002).decay(.25).sustain(0)
  .lpf(3500).room(.4).gain(.22)

// A robot voice through the vocoder
robot: note("<e3 e3 c3 d3>").struct("~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").syl("<[ro bo ta ko mo] [ro ka lo ki mo]>").talk(1).crush(8).pan(.6).gain(.3)

// A square-wave lead
lead: n("<[7 ~ 4 ~ 7 ~ 9 7] [~ ~ 4 ~ 2 ~ 0 ~]>").scale("E:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).decay(.15).sustain(.2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.15)

sketches.name: 1990s · Boom Bap Crates
sketches.description: Golden-era hip-hop: dusty swung drums, a crate-dug jazz loop through a bit-crusher, an upright bass, a horn sample and vinyl crackle.

sketches.name: 2000s · Pop-Punk Summer
sketches.description: Suburban pop-punk: driving power chords, an eighth-note bass, a skate-punk beat, a guitar melody and a gang 'whoa-oh' on the second half.
sketches.source:
setcpm(168/4)

// The gang vocal joins on the second half
const refrain = "<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>"

// A skate-punk beat
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ sd ~ bd bd sd ~").gain(.7),
  s("hh*8").hpf(6000).gain(.25),
  s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").gain(.3)
)

// Power chords: D, A, Bm, G
guitar: note("<[d3,a3,d4] [a2,e3,a3] [b2,f#3,b3] [g2,d3,g3]>").struct("x*8")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).shape(.6).lpf(2400)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.18)
bass: note("<d2 a1 b1 g1>").ply(8)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(700).decay(.1).sustain(.4).release(.05).gain(.42)

// A guitar melody
lead: note("<[f#4@3 e4 d4@2 e4@2] [c#4@6 a3@2] [d4 e4 f#4 a4 b4@2 a4 f#4] [g4@4 f#4@2 e4@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").shape(.4).lpf(3000).attack(.01).sustain(.6).release(.1).pan(.6).gain(.18)

// Whoa-oh-oh
gang: note("<[a3,d4,f#4] [a3,c#4,e4] [b3,d4,f#4] [b3,d4,g4]>").struct("x@3 x x@4")
  .mask(refrain).s("choir").syl("wo").attack(.05).release(.3).room(.3).gain(.3)

sketches.name: 2010s · Festival Drop
sketches.description: Main-stage EDM: four bars of build-up with an accelerating snare roll and a white-noise riser, then four bars of drop with a pumping supersaw.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)

// Four bars of build-up, then four bars of drop
const rising = "<1 1 1 1 0 0 0 0>"
const peak = "<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>"

// A plucked arpeggio whose filter opens over each half: Fm, Db, Ab, Eb
plucks: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 4").add("<0 -2 2 -1>").scale("F:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).lpf(saw.range(600, 4000).slow(4)).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)

// The build-up: a snare roll that speeds up and a rising noise sweep
roll: s("<sd*2 sd*4 sd*8 sd*16 ~ ~ ~ ~>").gain(saw.range(.15, .5)).hpf(400).room(.3)
riser: s("white").mask(rising).hpf(saw.range(300, 8000).slow(4)).gain(.07)

// The drop: kick, claps, a pumping supersaw and an off-beat bass
kick: s("bd*4").mask(peak).shape(.25).gain(.85)
clap: s("~ cp ~ cp").mask(peak).room(.3).gain(.45)
supersaw: note("<[f3,ab3,c4] [db3,f3,ab3] [ab3,c4,eb4] [eb3,g3,bb3]>").struct("x*8")
  .mask(peak).s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.4).lpf(4000)
  .gain("[.08 .2 .26 .3]*2").room(.4)
bass: note("<f1 db1 ab1 eb1>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").mask(peak)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(600).decay(.15).sustain(.3).gain(.45)

sketches.name: 2020s · Bedroom Hyperpop
sketches.description: Made on a laptop in a bedroom: sugary crushed supersaws, a distorted gliding 808, glitchy seeded hi-hat stutters, pitched-up vocal chops and glassy sparkles.
sketches.source:
setcpm(150/4)

// Half-time drums and glitchy, seeded hats
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ [cp,sd] ~ ~ ~").shape(.3).gain(.75)
hats: s("hh*8").sometimesBy(.4, x => x.ply("<2 3 4>")).seed("glitch").hpf(7000).gain(.3)

// A distorted 808 that glides between notes
b808: note("<[c2@3 c2 eb2@2 g1@2] [ab1@4 bb1@4]>")
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.06).shape(.5)
  .decay(1).sustain(.6).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Sugary, bit-crushed supersaw chords: Cm7, Abmaj7
chords: note("<[c4,eb4,g4,bb4] [ab3,c4,eb4,g4]>").struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.35).crush(10).lpf(5000)
  .decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.2).room(.3).gain(.18)

// Pitched-up vocal chops that stutter every other bar
chops: note("<[g5 eb5 c5 g5] [ab5 g5 eb5 c5]>").s("voice").syl("ya yi yo ya")
  .every(2, x => x.ply(2)).crush(9).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).pan(sine.slow(2)).gain(.22)

// Glassy sparkles
sparkle: n(irand(8).segment(16)).scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.6).seed("sparkle")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.1).sustain(0).pan(rand).gain(.1)
